The '''amethyst crystal''' was one of the several types of [[The Force/Legends|Force-imbued]] [[tasar crystal]]s that could be found on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. It was deep purple in [[Color/Legends|color]] and shared its name with<ref name="Journal15" /> the type of [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] known as [[Amethyst/Legends|amethyst]].<ref name="Queen">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref>

If an individual carried an amethyst [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] on their person for a number of [[Standard month/Legends|months]], they gradually became attuned to it and as a result became able to use&mdash;even if they were not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]&mdash;the [[ion generation]] [[Force power/Legends|Force ability]]. The ability allowed its user to more easily calm down upset beings and promote in them a feeling of good will, and even the most fervent skeptics of the Force-imbued tasar crystals had to begrudgingly admit that some of those crystals indeed exhibited a noticeable soothing effect.<ref name="Journal15" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWAJ15.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Amethyst crystals were introduced in ''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 15.]]
The amethyst crystal was mentioned in "[[Tasariq: The Crystal Planet]]," a [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' source article written by [[Tom Moldvay]] and [[Steve Miller]] and published in the [[November]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 15|fifteenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal15" />

The article suggests that, if the player characters are [[Mining/Legends|mining]] tasar crystals on Tasariq, they should have a chance of discovering Force-imbued crystals such as the amethyst crystal, with the probability ranging from one-in-six to 1-in-216 of finding one or three such crystals, respectively, for every seven [[Local day/Legends|days]] they spend working in an area with an abundance of crystals. Additionally, the article suggests that, should the gamemaster player wish to determine randomly what crystals in particular the characters discover, the chance of obtaining an amethyst crystal be one-in-thirty.<ref name="Journal15" />
